issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not mention Balaam (巴蘭) at all; it says 'he took him to the field of Zophim' (וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שְׂדֵה צֹפִים). The Chinese adds '田野的巴蘭' (Balaam of the field), which is an addition of a name not present in the Hebrew. The subject of the verb is implicit ('he'), and the location is 'the field of Zophim' (שְׂדֵה צֹפִים), not 'the field of Balaam'.

The Hebrew 'שְׂדֵה צֹפִים' means 'field of Zophim' (a place name), but the Chinese renders it as '田野的巴蘭' (the field of Balaam), which misidentifies the place name as a person's name and changes the meaning.
